supportingSources.label: Official American Pinball Houdini v21.10.25 update
Official American Pinball Houdini service manual

strategy.summary: Start a controllable Stage Mode or Movie Mode before Trunk and Seance Multiball, use the overlap for HOUDINI letters, and activate the Milkcan playfield multiplier only from a controlled Milkcan-loop-to-ramp combo.

quickInfo.name: Master Magician
quickInfo.summary: Seven HOUDINI letters track Stage modes, Movies, Magic Shop items, Jail Escapes, Secret Missions, and jackpot goals in both major multiballs.

quickInfo.name: Stage Mode
quickInfo.summary: Hit the stage curtain four times, make a clean Stage Alley shot, or shoot the Key Lane and hit the red Key Target to open the curtain. Shoot the Stage to start the mode; a clean Stage Alley entry starts it at 2x.

quickInfo.name: Mode order
quickInfo.summary: A Stage Mode and Movie Mode cannot run together and must start before a multiball to overlap it.

quickInfo.name: Trunk Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Use the right inner loop for locks, make the required jackpot shots, then return to the trunk for the Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Seance Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell SEANCE, then complete the ordered jackpot sequence toward its Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Milkcan multiplier
quickInfo.summary: A Milkcan loop followed by the ramp starts or raises a timed 2x, 3x, or 4x playfield-scoring multiplier.

steps.text: Hit the stage curtain four times, make a clean Stage Alley shot, or shoot the Key Lane and hit the red Key Target to open the curtain. Shoot the Stage to start the selected mode.
Select a Stage Mode or Movie Mode whose marked shots remain accessible during Multiball, then start it before any Multiball. A clean Stage Alley entry starts a Stage Mode at 2x.
While the mode is active, complete its marked shots and use orbit shots for added Stage time when needed.
Start Trunk or Seance Multiball, then add the other if it is ready.
During Trunk Multiball, collect the lit jackpot shots and return to the trunk for the Super Jackpot; secure at least three Trunk jackpots for its HOUDINI letter.
During Seance Multiball, follow the lit sequence and collect at least two jackpots for its HOUDINI letter.
Use the Milkcan loop-to-ramp playfield multiplier only when both shots feed safely, then place the remaining mode and multiball shots inside that window.
Complete each of the ten Stage Mode features and five Movie Mode features.
Complete five Jail Escapes and five Secret Missions.
Collect three Trunk Multiball jackpots and two Seance Multiball jackpots.
Use the seven completed objectives to enter Master Magician.

editionDifferences.pro: The original production game uses the common Houdini rules and service platform.
editionDifferences.premium: Later cabinet packages and accessories do not establish a separate rules edition; installed code and operator adjustments remain decisive.

techniques.name: Mode-first stacking
techniques.instruction: Start one Stage or Movie mode before Trunk or Seance Multiball because those single-ball modes cannot be added after multiball begins.

techniques.name: Clean Stage Alley start
techniques.instruction: Use the Stage Alley entry when its feed is controlled to begin the next Stage mode at 2x.

techniques.name: Milkcan multiplier placement
techniques.instruction: Complete Milkcan loop-to-ramp immediately before the safest valuable mode shots instead of letting the timed multiplier decay during setup.

cautions.issue: The Magic target area can activate magnets and produce an uncontrolled return.
cautions.response: Test the installed magnet behavior during ball save and avoid forcing the targets without a useful award ready.

cautions.issue: The detailed rules baseline is 18.12.12, older than the official 21.10.25 package.
cautions.response: Use the current display and operator menu for exact timers, awards, and difficulty adjustments.

strategy.simpleOverview: A Stage mode can continue into Multiball, but it must start first. Hit the curtain four times, make a clean Stage Alley shot, or complete the Key Lane and red Key Target to open the curtain. Shoot the Stage before Multiball because a mode cannot be added afterward; the right inner loop builds Trunk Multiball, and the Milkcan loop-to-ramp combo starts playfield X.
strategy.overview: Seven major objectives award HOUDINI letters. Hit the curtain four times, make a clean Stage Alley shot, or complete the Key Lane and red Key Target to open the curtain. Shoot the Stage before Trunk or Seance Multiball because modes cannot be added after Multiball starts; use the Milkcan loop-to-ramp combo when the active shots are ready for playfield X.
